set(_checks_root "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}")
function(lmx_catalog_check name source)
    add_executable(lmx_catalog_check_${name} "${source}")
    lmx_c99_target(lmx_catalog_check_${name})
    target_link_libraries(lmx_catalog_check_${name} PRIVATE LMX::all)
    if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
        target_compile_options(lmx_catalog_check_${name} PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
    endif()
    add_test(NAME catalog.combined_${name} COMMAND lmx_catalog_check_${name})
    set_tests_properties(catalog.combined_${name} PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 15)
endfunction()
lmx_catalog_check(base "${_checks_root}/base.c")
lmx_catalog_check(numeric "${_checks_root}/../numeric_extra/tests/numeric_extra_check.c")
lmx_catalog_check(alternatives "${_checks_root}/../numeric_extra/tests/numeric_alternatives_check.c")
lmx_catalog_check(tomfloat "${_checks_root}/../numeric_extra/tests/libtomfloat_check.c")
lmx_catalog_check(network "${_checks_root}/../network_extra/tests/network_smoke.c")
